meta.description: Registry of data sources feeding the keyword database. Seed entries are honest about being estimates; production data must come from the CSV/API sources listed below.

sources.name: Seed: manual curation
sources.description: Hand-curated core keywords defined per dream entity in scripts/entities/. Used to bootstrap the database.

sources.name: Seed: pattern generation
sources.description: Keywords derived from entity names and related terms using documented query patterns. Volume bands are estimates.

sources.name: Google Keyword Planner CSV
sources.description: Real search volume / competition data. Import into the database via data/raw/keyword-planner.csv (schema: keyword, avg_monthly_searches, competition, cpc_usd).

sources.name: Google Suggest API
sources.description: Autocomplete suggestions reserved for a future integration pass (interface stubbed).

sources.name: Competitor keyword CSV
sources.description: Keywords observed on competitor sites (URL slugs, page titles). See data/raw/competitor-keywords.csv.
